name: Dcm
description: Configuration of the Dcm (Diagnostic Communications Manager) module.

children.name: DcmConfigSet
children.description: This container contains the configuration parameters and sub containers of the DCM module supporting multiple configuration sets.

children.name: DcmDsd
children.description: These parameters configure the Diagnostic Service Dispatcher submodule.

children.name: DcmDsdRequestManufacturerNotificationEnabled
children.description: Allows to enable or disable the requested notification mechanism for the Manufacturer.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDsdRequestSupplierNotificationEnabled
children.description: Allows to enable or disable the requested notification mechanism for the Supplier.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDsdServiceRequestManufacturerNotification
children.description: The name of this container is used to define the name of the R-Port through which the DCM accesses the interface ServiceRequestNotification.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The R-Port is named ServiceRequestManufacturerNotification_{Name} where {Name} is the name of the container DcmDsdServiceRequestManufacturerNotification. The lowerMultiplicity is 0: If DcmDsdRequestManufacturerNotificationEnabled = false the Indication API is not available.

children.name: DcmDsdServiceRequestSupplierNotification
children.description: The name of this container is used to define the name of the R-Port through which the DCM accesses the interface ServiceRequestNotification.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The R-Port is named ServiceRequestSupplierNotification_<SWC> where <SWC> is the name of the container DcmDsdServiceRequestSupplierNotification. The lowerMultiplicity is 0: If DcmDsdRequestSupplierNotification = false the Indication API is not available.

children.name: DcmDsdServiceTable
children.description: This container contains the configuration (DSD parameters) for a Service Identifier Table.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Note: It is allowed to add OBD services to a DcmDsdServiceTable related to a UDS Protocol. But it is not allowed to add UDS services to a DcmDsdServiceTable related to an OBD Protocol.

children.name: DcmDsdSidTabId
children.description: Due to using possibly more service tables, the unique DcmDsdSidTabId can be used to identify them.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDsdService
children.description: This container contains the configuration (DSD parameters) for a Service.

children.name: DcmDsdServiceUsed
children.description: Allows to activate or deactivate the usage of a Service. This parameter can be used for multi-purpose ECUs.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true - service is available false - service is not available
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDsdSidTabFnc
children.description: Callback function of the ECU Supplier specific component for the particular service. The function's prototype is as described for <Module>_<DiagnosticService>. If this parameter is not configured, the service is handled Dcm-internally.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDsdSidTabServiceId
children.description: Identifier of the service.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The possible service identifiers are defined in ISO 14229-1 and ISO 15031-5.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDsdSidTabSubfuncAvail
children.description: Information about whether the service has subfunctions or not. This parameter is used for the handling of the "suppressPosRspMsgIndicationBit" as defined in ISO 14229-1, which can be used as a reference for the configuration.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true - service has subfunctions, suppressPosRspMsgIndicationBit is available false - service has no subfunctions, suppressPosRspMsgIndicationBit is not available
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDsdSidTabModeRuleRef
children.description: Reference to a DcmDspModeRule which controls the execution of the service. If there is no reference configured, no mode rule check shall be performed.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDsdSidTabSecurityLevelRef
children.description: Reference to a Security Level in which the service is allowed to be executed. Multiple references are allowed for a service.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Please refer to ISO 14229-1, ISO 15031-5 and chapter "Verification of the Service Security Access levels." If there is no reference configured, no service security verification shall be performed.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDsdSidTabSessionLevelRef
children.description: Reference to a Session Level in which the service is allowed to be executed. Multiple references are allowed for a service.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Please refer to ISO 14229-1, ISO 15031-5 and chapter "Verification of the Diagnostic Session". If there is no reference configured, no diagnostic session verification shall be performed.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDsdSubService
children.description: This container contains the configuration (DSD parameters) for a subservice of a service. Only those services may have subservices, which have the DcmDsdSidTabSubfuncAvail configured as TRUE and have no DcmDsdSidTabFnc configured.

children.name: DcmDsdSubServiceFnc
children.description: Callback function of the ECU Supplier specific component for the particular service. The function's prototype is as described for <Module>_<DiagnosticService>_<SubService>.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If this parameter is not configured, the subservice is handled Dcm-internally.

children.description: Identifier of the subservice.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDsdSubServiceUsed
children.description: Allows to activate or deactivate the usage of a Subservice. This parameter can be used for multi-purpose ECUs.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true - subservice is available false - subservice is not available.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDsdSubServiceSecurityLevelRef
children.description: Reference to a Security Level in which the subservice is allowed to be executed. Multiple references are allowed for a subservice.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Please refer to ISO 14229-1, ISO 15031-5 and chapter "Verification of the Service Security Access levels." If there is no reference configured, no subservice security verification shall be performed.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDsdSubServiceSessionLevelRef
children.description: Reference to a Session Level in which the subservice is allowed to be executed. Multiple references are allowed for a subservice.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Please refer to ISO 14229-1, ISO 15031-5 and chapter "Verification of the Diagnostic Session". If there is no reference configured, no diagnostic session verification shall be performed.

children.name: DcmDsl
children.description: These parameters configure the Diagnostic Session Layer submodule.

children.name: DcmDslBuffer
children.description: This container contains the configuration of a diagnostic buffer.

children.name: DcmDslBufferSize
children.description: Size of the diagnostic buffer in bytes.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: For a linear buffer the size shall be as large as the longest diagnostic message (request or response). For a paged buffer the size has impacts on the application performance.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslCallbackDCMRequestService
children.description: Each DcmDslCallbackDCMRequestService container defines an R-Port with the CallbackDCMRequestServices interface which the Dcm uses to ask permission for protocol changes from the application software. The R-Port has the name CallbackDCMRequestServices_<SWC> where <SWC> is the name of this container.

children.name: DcmDslDiagResp
children.description: This container contains the configuration of the automatic requestCorrectlyReceivedResponsePending response management in the Dcm.

children.name: DcmDslDiagRespMaxNumRespPend
children.description: Maximum number of negative responses with response code 0x78 (requestCorrectlyReceivedResponsePending) allowed for a request. If Dcm reaches this limit, an automatic 0x10 (generalReject) final response will be trasmitted and the service processing will be cancelled.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslDiagRespOnSecondDeclinedRequest
children.description: Defines the reaction upon a second request (ClientB) that can not be processed (e.g. due to priority assessment).

metadata.INTRODUCTION: TRUE: when the second request (Client B) can not be processed, it shall be answered with NRC21 BusyRepeatRequest. FALSE: when the second request (Client B) can not be processed, it shall not be responded.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslProtocol
children.description: This container contains the configurations of the diagnostic protocols used in Dcm.

children.name: DcmDslProtocolRow
children.description: This container contains the configuration of one particular diagnostic protocol used in Dcm.

children.name: DcmDslProtocolID
children.description: The diagnostic protocol type for the DCM DSL protocol that is being configured.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Implementation Type: Dcm_ProtocolType
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslProtocolMaximumResponseSize
children.description: This parameter is mandatory and defines the maximum length of the response message in case DcmPagedBufferEnabled == TRUE

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslProtocolPreemptTimeout
children.description: This parameter is the timeout value used in protocol preemption if this protocol preempts another diagnostic protocol. The protocol shall be started maximum DcmDslProtocolPreemptTimeout time after the first request in the new protocol.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslProtocolPriority
children.description: Protocol priority used during protocol preemption. A higher priority protocol may preempt a lower priority protocol.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Lower numeric values represent higher protocol priority: 0 - Highest protocol priority 255 - Lowest protocol priority
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslProtocolRowUsed
children.description: Allows to activate or deactivate the usage of a Protocol. This parameter can be used for multi-purpose ECUs.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true - protocol is available false - protocol is not available.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslProtocolTransType
children.description: This parameter is used only if the protocol is of type DCM_ROE_ON_xxx. It selects the transmission type of the protocol.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.LITERALS: TYPE1 AUTOSAR_ECUC TYPE2 AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DcmSendRespPendOnTransToBoot
children.description: Parameter specifying if the ECU should send a NRC 0x78 (response pending) before transitioning to the bootloader (parameter set to TRUE) or if the transition shall be initiated without sending NRC 0x78 (parameter set to FALSE).

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmTimStrP2ServerAdjust
children.description: This parameter is used to guarantee that the diagnostic response is available on the bus before reaching P2 by adjusting the current DcmDspSessionP2ServerMax.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This parameter mainly represents the software architecture dependent communication delay between the time the transmission is initiated by DCM and the time when the message is actually transmitted to the bus. The parameter value is defined in seconds and must be a multiple of DcmTaskTime.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmTimStrP2StarServerAdjust
children.description: This parameter is used to guarantee that the diagnostic response is available on the bus before reaching P2Star by adjusting the current DcmDspSessionP2StarServerMax.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This parameter mainly represents the software architecture dependent communication delay between the time the transmission is initiated by DCM and the time when the message is actually transmitted to the bus. The parameter value is defined in seconds and must be a multiple of DcmTaskTime.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslProtocolRxBufferRef
children.description: Reference to a configured diagnostic buffer that is used for diagnostic request reception for the protocol.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslProtocolSIDTable
children.description: Reference to a service table that is used for diagnostic request processing for this protocol.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslProtocolTxBufferRef
children.description: Reference to a configured diagnostic buffer that is used for diagnostic response transmission for the protocol.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslConnection
children.description: This container contains the configuration of a communication channel for one particular protocol.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Note that it is allowed to communicate with multiple testers, therefore multiple connections may be configured for a protocol.

children.name: DcmDslMainConnection
children.description: This container contains the configuration for a main connection of a diagnostic protocol. Additionally it may contain references to ROE and Periodic connections if the protocol type or protocol transmission type needs them.

children.name: DcmDslProtocolRxTesterSourceAddr
children.description: Source address of the tester which uses this connection for diagnostic communication.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The parameter is not required for generic connections, where the MetaDataLength of a PDU is greater than or equal to 1.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslPeriodicTransmissionConRef
children.description: Reference to a periodic transmission connection which is used for the processing of periodic transmission events.

children.description: Reference to a ResponseOnEvent connection which is used for the processing of ResponseOnEvent events.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslProtocolComMChannelRef
children.description: Reference to the ComMChannel on which the DcmDslProtocolRxPdu is received and the DcmDslProtocolTxPdu is transmitted.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslProtocolRx
children.description: This container contains the configuration parameters of a reception channel in a diagnostic connection.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Note that the combination of a DcmDspProtocolRxPduId and a DcmDspProtocolRxAddrType shall be unique for each configured reception channel. Also note that only one channel with DcmDspProtocolRxAddrType == DCM_PHYSICAL_TYPE is allowed for a connection.

children.name: DcmDslProtocolRxAddrType
children.description: Selects the addressing type of the reception channel. Physical addressing is used for 1:1 communication, functional addressing is used for 1:N communication.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: For details refer to ISO 14229-1.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.LITERALS: DCM_FUNCTIONAL_TYPE AUTOSAR_ECUC DCM_PHYSICAL_TYPE AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DcmDslProtocolRxPduId
children.description: Identifier of the PDU that is used for this reception channel.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslProtocolRxPduRef
children.description: Reference to a Pdu in EcuC that is used for this reception channel.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslProtocolTxPduRef
children.description: Reference to a Pdu in EcuC that is used for this transmission channel.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.description: This container contains the configuration of a periodic transmission connection.

children.description: This container contains the configuration of a transmission channel for a periodic transmission connection.

children.name: DcmDslPeriodicTxConfirmationPduId
children.description: Identifier of the PDU that is used by the lower level module for transmission confirmation of responses on this channel.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDslPeriodicTxPduRef
children.description: Reference to a Pdu in EcuC that is used for this periodic transmission channel.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.description: This container contains the configuration of a ResponseOnEvent connection.

children.description: Reference to a Pdu in EcuC that is used for this ResponseOnEvent transmission connection.

children.name: DcmDsp
children.description: These parameters apply to Diagnostic Service Processing. There will always be one set of these parameters per Dcm.

children.name: DcmDspDDDIDcheckPerSourceDID
children.description: Defines the check for session, security and mode dependencies per source DIDs with a ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22).

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: Dcm module shall check the session, security and mode dependencies per source DIDs with a ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) with DID in the range 0xF200 to 0xF3FF false: Dcm module shall not check the session, security and mode dependencies per source DIDs with a ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) with DID in the range 0xF200 to 0xF3FF
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDspDataDefaultEndianness
children.description: Defines the default endianness belonging to a DID, RID or PID if the corresponding data does not define an endianness.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.LITERALS: BIG_ENDIAN AUTOSAR_ECUC LITTLE_ENDIAN AUTOSAR_ECUC OPAQUE AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DcmDspEnableObdMirror
children.description: DcmDspEnableObdMirror defines whether a DID inside the OBD range (F400-F4FF) and the OBD InfoType range (F800-F8FF) shall get the DID value as defined for OBD on reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), or not.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDspMaxDidToRead
children.description: Indicates the maximum allowed DIDs in a single "ReadDataByIdentifier" request.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDspMaxPeriodicDidToRead
children.description: Indicates the maximum allowed periodicDIDs which can be read in a single "ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier" request.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: DcmDspPowerDownTime
children.description: This parameter indicates to the client the minimum time of the stand-by sequence the server will remain in the power-down sequence.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The resolution of this parameter is one second per count. The following values are valid: 00 - FE hex: 0 - 254 s powerDownTime; FF hex: indicates a failure or time not available. This value needs to be defined by the integrator according to the ECU capabilities. This parameter has to be available if the service EcuReset, sub-service enableRapidPowerShutDown is configured.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
